item.title: Version 1.50.13 (145)
item.description:
External-drive TIFF export fix

  • Checks free space on the actual selected TIFF destination.
  • Correctly measures external and removable drives instead of reporting 0 B.
  • Handles new output folders and unknown capacity readings safely.
